title: Reference Counting by Hand
prompt: A file-scope `int rcs_alive = 0;` is already in your editor. Implement `rc_t *rc_create(void)` (refs = 1, counter++), `void rc_hold(rc_t *r)` (refs++), `void rc_release(rc_t *r)` (refs--; when it reaches 0: counter--, free; NULL is a no-op), and `int rc_refs(const rc_t *r)`.

tests.name: ref arithmetic
tests.hint: holds raise, releases lower, the last one frees — the counter proves it.

tests.name: over-release guard
tests.hint: Release on an already-freed object must not be possible through the API; NULL release is a no-op.
